Patient with children

Fast and precise

Walk in or book

Monday to Wednesday without appointment, last arrival 18:00. Friday and Saturday by appointment on 24 254600.

Ten years of haircuts

My Barber Shop has been cutting hair in Larnaca for ten years, as it says on its anniversary poster. The owner cuts herself, and customers describe a friendly, family atmosphere, fluent English and a shop where parents bring their children.

What customers say

Three of 220 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“The most professional barber ever! She is fast but accurate, she is perseptive, her suggestions to the point. She is magnificent with kids!!! My son wouldn't accept a haircut from anyone, until she smiled to him and talked to him gently. That was it! He couldn't wait for his next haircut! Highly recommended!!!”

Google review
“The best of the best! Very fast and precise, very friendly staff and reasonable prices. I visit this barber shop every time needed for the last 4 years and I always have the best experience! Strongly recommended to book an appointment if you have a schedule but even on the days without appointment, they will do their best to serve you as soon as possible as they are always busy due to their excellent service!”

Google review
“Great barbershop! Friendly staff, clean space, and a sharp cut every time. Highly recommend.”
